description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing itself, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Myr Scrapling dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {1}.
Repeat.
